Process.Name: proc_BatteryElectricTruck_OnRunInitialised

Step.Name: OnRunInitialised
Step.Description: **Fire OnRunInitialised:** Trigger OnRunInitialised event for each configured truck in tbl_BatteryElectricTrucks
